subject.title: Base de datos dev ligera con sandboxes desechables

question: Should the first implementation be limited to local safe tooling around `Hamelyn_DEV_BASE` sandboxes, or should it also define the refresh/anonymization pipeline now?
rationale: Current code provides partial guard patterns, but maintainers need to choose how much data-governance policy belongs in the first PR before automation can safely implement it.

options.title: Start with safe local tooling
options.body: Build audit, index comparison, create/drop sandbox commands and docs first, leaving refresh/anonymization as a follow-up once the operational policy is clearer.

options.title: Design full data pipeline first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers specify how `Hamelyn_DEV_BASE` is refreshed, anonymized, owned, and reviewed.

options.title: Keep manual for now
options.body: Document the existing fulfillment sandbox pattern and defer generalized tooling until repeated use proves the workflow shape.

recommendation.title: Start with safe local tooling
recommendation.body: Build audit, index comparison, create/drop sandbox commands and docs first, leaving refresh/anonymization as a follow-up once the operational policy is clearer.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn authored the issue and also introduced the closest existing sandbox/audit patterns in git history.
